PLAN 12 | SHOTS 28-31 | THE FINAL COMMAND
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 4 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_ZAHHAK = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_STAFF = {{PROP_STAFF}}
PROP_BLADE = {{PROP_BLADE}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_OBEDIENCE. Cat sits alive at the far half of the left ledge. Blade lies at the near end, handle beside Shahrnaz’s right hand, at least seventy centimeters from the cat. Arnavaz remains on her original right-hand mark, watching the ledge. Guards stay behind. Zahhak supports himself on the right-hand staff.

SHOT 28 | 00:00-00:03 | THE GESTURE
50mm medium view of Zahhak from the sisters’ side. Right hand remains on the staff; his left index finger indicates the blade and then the cat in one economical motion. His body stays still and weighted. The gesture is the entire command.
SHOT 29 | 00:03-00:07 | THE HAND OBEYS
Cut to 65mm on Shahrnaz’s right hand at the ledge. She closes her fingers around the handle and lifts the single blade. Continue the movement into her wrist and forearm; retain the cat at the opposite end in soft background. Her left hand hangs empty.
SHOT 30 | 00:07-00:10 | THE WITNESS
Cut to 65mm close medium on Arnavaz. Her head follows the blade; she takes one shallow breath. Her lowered hands remain loose. The dusty left sleeve and collapsed shoulder preserve the aftermath of violence. Hold the absence of intervention.
SHOT 31 | 00:10-00:15 | THE UNFINISHED ACT
Cut to 40mm side medium framing Shahrnaz, her right forearm and the cat on the ledge. She takes a half-step closer and raises the blade slowly to waist height, its tip held away from the cat. Her left hand begins reaching toward it. At 14.5 seconds, while the cat is alive and the blade remains separated from its body, hard cut to black. Hold black and absolute silence for the remaining half-second.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Same reduced hall light and fixed shadows. Keep the cat readable in soft light, the lifted blade a restrained edge highlight, masks unchanged. Exposure stays steady until the hard cut.
SOUND
Zahhak’s sleeve, fingers closing on a handle, light metal scraping stone, a quiet cat breath and Arnavaz’s small inhalation. Sound stops at 14.5 seconds with the cut.
END STATE AND EDIT
At local 14.5 seconds, cut to black while the blade is held stationary and separated from the living cat. The final half-second is black and silent. The episode ends at intention, before contact.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Revision — the previous attempt was rejected for these reasons. Fix them:
- PLAN 12 | SHOTS 28A–28C | THE OFFERING

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9.
Three shots lasting four, four and seven seconds.
The final half-second is black and silent.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his established shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s chamber = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}

PROP REFERENCES:
Blade = {{PROP_BLADE}}
Staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

FIXED BLOCKING:

Shahrnaz occupies the western mark and faces EAST toward Arnavaz.
Arnavaz occupies the eastern mark and faces WEST toward Shahrnaz.

They stand seventy centimeters apart beneath the same overhead spotlight.

The camera remains NORTH of their east-west interaction axis throughout:
Arnavaz always appears screen-left, facing screen-right.
Shahrnaz always appears screen-right, facing screen-left.

Zahhak stands farther north, behind the camera in darkness, holding his staff. The camera concentrates on the sisters.

Shahrnaz supports the cat against her chest.
Arnavaz holds the blade low in her right hand; her left hand is empty.
Preserve Arnavaz’s lowered left shoulder and dusty costume.

SHOT 28A | 00:00–00:04 | THE OFFERING BEGINS

50mm medium two-shot from north, looking south.

Show the sisters in opposing three-quarter profiles:
Arnavaz left, Shahrnaz right.

Shahrnaz looks toward Arnavaz, then lowers her masked head toward the cat.

She carefully adjusts her hands: one supports the cat’s chest and the other supports its hindquarters. She moves it approximately twenty centimeters away from her own torso, toward the space between them.

The cat’s weight remains fully supported. Its ears turn toward Arnavaz.

Shahrnaz’s movement is deliberate and emotionally vacant.

SHOT 28B | 00:04–00:08 | THE HAND THAT USED TO PROTECT

Cut closer from the SAME northern side, using 65mm at the cat’s height.

Shahrnaz’s forearms enter from screen-right.
Arnavaz’s torso and empty left hand occupy screen-left.

The cat lies securely supported between Shahrnaz’s hands, close enough to her body for stable support.

Shahrnaz completes the offering movement and holds still. Her fingers maintain support without stroking the fur.

Arnavaz’s empty left hand lifts a few centimeters toward the animal, then pauses short of contact.

Her right hand and blade remain low, away from the cat.

SHOT 28C | 00:08–00:15 | SHARED OBEDIENCE

Return to a 40mm two-shot from the same northern side.

Arnavaz remains screen-left, facing right.
Shahrnaz remains screen-right, facing left.

Begin wide enough to include both masked heads, both pairs of hands, the cat and the lowered blade.

Arnavaz takes one small step toward Shahrnaz.

The camera advances slowly thirty centimeters, retaining both sisters together. Shahrnaz holds the cat steadily toward her, watching without withdrawing.

Arnavaz extends her empty left hand toward the cat. Her right hand slowly raises the blade from beside her thigh to waist height, the tip still separated from the animal.

Their breathing remains quiet. Their movements suggest complete cooperation.

At local 14.5 seconds, before the blade touches the cat, cut directly to black.

Hold black and absolute silence for the remaining half-second.

IMAGE AND PERFORMANCE:

The hard overhead spotlight continues unchanged. The surrounding room remains near-black, with readable texture on masks, hands, clothing and fur.

Keep the final camera approach almost still. The disturbing change is the sisters’ calm cooperation after their earlier terror.

The cat remains alive and supported throughout.

SOUND:

Sparse breathing, quiet fabric movement, one soft footstep and a faint sound from the cat.

All sound ends with the cut to black at 14.5 seconds.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
